data.title: bn-28hup: one rule before acknowledgement — a requested task does no work in any family until it acknowledges (RFC 0026 c55)

data.body: [risk:high] Exact-range security review. Finding: none. Failure modes: missed actor or recipient attribution could accept impossible work; wrong phase or family-presence handling could reject valid projections; fault ordering could hide a stronger refusal. Edge cases: region and deadline requests, created/running/suspended tasks, absent cancellation telemetry, other-task events, timer fire, transfers, channel receipts, cleanup, terminal and unknown entities. Rollback: revert bf46fd29; no wire tag or schema changes occur, but the prior inconsistent acceptance window returns. Monitoring: track BeforeAcknowledgement and UnreportedRequest verdict counts, A7 model/lift disagreement counts, and projection regressions. Validation: inspected the full 78181cab..bf46fd29 range and all 13 changed files; traced EventBody::own_work_of at family.rs:247-268 through this pre-lift guard; compared the independent model at primitive_conformance_model.rs:1264-1353 and 1446-1457; checked binding checkpoints and timer-fire production at binding.rs:1142-1191, 1222-1277, 1312-1356, and 2969-2989. The new tests cover all five acting families, receipts, cleanup, phase presence, and all 32 projections. I did not run tests because this reviewer may write only Seal metadata.

data.reason: LGTM: full persisted range 78181cab..bf46fd29 reviewed. No security blockers. The risk:critical human-approval gate remains separate.
Risk analysis is informational; no finding or action required.
